messages:
devon: Heads-up — starting a staggered rollout for model-serving v3.4.2 to canary in eu-west-1 now. Change window 22:00–23:30 UTC. Watch p50/p95 and 5xxs. I'll be on standby.

deploybot: Deploy started: rollout_id=rl-2026-03-21-1765436789 -> canary subset (10%). CI checks passed. Notifying channels.

ryan: Copy. If we see >10% request errors or p95 latency +200ms from baseline, execute the evacuation lifeboat. Steps in the lifeboat runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/evacuation-lifeboat (TL;DR below).

amanda: Pasting the quick actions from runbook for visibility:
```
1) Run health check query on /health and /v1/generate across canary nodes.
2) Pin traffic: curl -X POST https://api.redwood/route-management/pin -d '{"route":"model-serving","version":"v3.4.1","percent":100}' 
3) Scale up dedicated pool: terraform apply -var='pool=dedicated-small' -target=module.gpu_pool
4) Purge prefix cache: redis-cli -h kv-cache flushdb (confirm with #eng-platform)
5) Open incident channel and call out SRE on-call.
```

amanda: Also note the graceful-degrade toggle if latency spikes but errors stay low: set header X-RW-Degrade: soft -> routes will use shorter context window. Link: https://docs.redwood/ops/graceful-degrade

ryan: For quick pinning via CLI (devs):
```bash
# pin route to previous stable version
rwctl route pin --route model-serving --version v3.4.1 --confirm
```

devon: Added the runbook anchor to the release notes and the deploy event. I've uploaded the evacuation checklist to the shared runbooks index: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/index#evacuation-lifeboat. Note: metric alarms to watch are model.latency.p95, model.errors.5xx.rate, infra.gpu.queue_depth.

oncall-bot: Acknowledged. If deploybot reports failure state or rollback requested, this channel will be auto-updated and page the eng-sre roster. Use @oncall to escalate.

ryan: One more: if we pin, leave canary nodes alive for 15m to verify no traffic regressions, then deprovision canary-only scaled replicas. Amanda, can you own cache purge if needed?

amanda: On it. Will post timestamps and confirm once flush complete.

devon: Thanks — we prefer lifeboat over full rollback unless data corruption observed. Keep posts short and include metric screenshots if possible. I'll mark this rollout active in the spreadsheet.

oncall-bot: Deploybot update: rollout rl-2026-03-21-1765436789 -> canary at 10% healthy. Monitoring enabled.

(reacted :thumbsup: by devon, amanda)
